categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: general equipment manufacturing (pump industry) and environmental governance. The manufacturing segment, accounting for about 87% of revenue, focuses on the R&D, production, and sales of stainless steel centrifugal pumps. The environmental governance segment involves hazardous waste disposal, environmental consulting, surveying and design, and environmental project operations.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in stainless steel stamping and welding centrifugal pump technology, with extensive R&D in multi-stage centrifugal pumps. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including semi-automated welding, precision casting, and digital supply chain management. The company also invests in smart manufacturing platforms, IoT, AI, and variable frequency technologies to enhance pump performance and energy efficiency.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span municipal water supply and drainage, environmental water treatment, industrial manufacturing, HVAC, agriculture irrigation, fire protection, and emerging sectors like energy storage and data centers. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and North America, with products used in water treatment plants, industrial facilities, and infrastructure projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily in China with significant domestic market presence. The company has expanded overseas with subsidiaries and service centers in Vietnam, Saudi Arabia, Singapore, the USA, and Spain, covering over 90 countries. It leverages the Belt and Road Initiative to deepen international market penetration.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on the design, manufacturing, and sales of pump products and environmental services. It sources raw materials like motors, stainless steel, and castings, and delivers finished pump products and environmental solutions to end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening core pump manufacturing, accelerating product innovation in high-end and specialized pumps, expanding digital and smart manufacturing capabilities, and optimizing environmental business structure. R&D focuses on energy-efficient pumps, smart control systems, corrosion-resistant materials, and environmental technology innovations such as hazardous waste resource recovery.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of pumps and related equipment, environmental consulting fees, hazardous waste disposal services, and project operation income. The company also earns from engineering contracts, government subsidies, and investment income from asset disposals.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer in stainless steel multi-stage centrifugal pumps, holding a strong position in the mid-to-high-end market segment. It competes with global pump giants like Grundfos, KSB, Xylem, and Ebara in high-end markets, while leveraging cost and service advantages for domestic and emerging markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 5.05 billion, a slight decline from the previous year, with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 218 million, showing growth. The company maintains a stable asset base of over RMB 8.2 billion and continues to invest around 4.86% of revenue in R&D. Overseas revenue grew by nearly 15%, reflecting international expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and energy-efficient stainless steel centrifugal pumps with broad application scenarios. It differentiates through advanced manufacturing technology, strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, and a robust direct sales and service network. Its environmental segment offers integrated hazardous waste treatment and consulting services, enhancing sustainability and regulatory compliance for clients.
